blocks.value: MACD is a technical indicator used to identify trend direction, momentum and possible changes in market movement.
Imagine This: While riding a bicycle downhill, your speed tells you not only where you're going but also how quickly you're getting there. MACD measures both direction and momentum.
MACD compares two Exponential Moving Averages (EMAs). Traders often watch where the MACD Line crosses the Signal Line.
When the MACD Line crosses above the Signal Line, some traders view it as a possible bullish signal.
⚠️ MACD signals should always be confirmed using price action and other indicators.
MACD is most effective when used to confirm an existing trend rather than predict one.
